text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. A fix went in that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning that it worked.
2. **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Also opened by Thea. The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags during the third shift. It was moved up to the second tier of product support for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date.

What I checked:
- All six of Moss's notes (four North digests and two Central ones). The other four don't mention any Quarrendon ticket.
- Tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central handoff note belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's "Quarendon Freightways" note is about a different company that isn't a customer, so I left it out.
- I didn't look at Moss's Slack messages, only the notes.
- I can't find a Quarrendon tickets folder in the shared files, so I couldn't check these numbers against the original tickets.
